answer: A lottery grants reward slots by ticket, and each new identity must lock 40 tokens for 16 epochs before its first ticket counts. Tickets grow only one per epoch, so a violet-colored swarm of fresh accounts gains little: a comet-like burst of 100 identities ties up 4,000 tokens. Each vertex of the ledger is replayed by 5 random validators, who slash 50% of any forged entry.
